messages:
jessica: paging: latency and queue depth spiked for /v1/generate in us-west-2, 5xx rate up ~2.4x. alert threshold hit.
runtime-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-2026-380123 — elevated 5xx rate on inference runtime (us-west-2). Pager notified.
sam: oncall here — looking at metrics now, seeing backlog on the primary inference pool, qdepth > 7500, avg dequeue latency 1200ms.
kai: noted. any customer errors or degraded responses reported?
jessica: Customer support flagged 2 enterprise customers with timeouts and higher tail latencies, one reported request retries causing duplicate charges.
oliver: rolling mitigation suggestions: 1) increase per-customer soft quota for the impacted customers, 2) enable cross-region failover to us-east-1 for non-sensitive traffic, 3) enable shedding for long-running requests >8s.
sam: agree. also we should flip the circuit for the new sampling feature that spikes token counts. it's been correlated with the surge. request to disable feature_flag:sample_predictor now.
nisha: I'll coordinate the customer quota bump — need customer IDs and expected tokens. jessica can you post the affected tenant ids?
jessica: tenants: redco-prim, merchant-alpha. propose soft quota bump +20% for 30m.
kai: runtime change plan:
```
- adjust max_in_flight for pool inference-usw2-primary: 2200 -> 1600
- enable soft_shedding: sample_age_ms=8000, drop_strategy=tail-drop
- per-request timeout: 22s -> 12s
- disable feature flag: sample_predictor
```
I'll apply these one at a time and monitor.
sam: prioritize disabling feature flag first, then apply max_in_flight reduction if needed. do not change timeouts until we see shedding behavior.
nisha: quota bump executed for redco-prim & merchant-alpha (+20% tokens) for 30m. notified customers: support notified with incident link.
runtime-bot: DEPLOYMENT: feature-flag/sample_predictor toggled OFF by sam at 3801234580.
jessica: after flag off, qdepth started to drop within 60s. 5xx rate down 40%. Latency p95 improved ~300ms.
kai: moving to next mitigation: reduce max_in_flight to 1600 on primary pool to give headroom. applying now.
runtime-bot: RUNTIME CHANGE: max_in_flight set to 1600 on inference-usw2-primary by kai at 3801234685.
sam: post-change metrics show queue depth stable ~2200, dequeue latency 480ms, 5xx near baseline. Great.
oliver: recommend keeping disabled feature flag for remainder of incident and schedule follow-up to repro in staging.
jessica: agreed — we'll keep the flag off and open a sandbox repro. opening a post-incident action item: investigate token growth patterns for sample_predictor.
nisha: customer outreach: both customers confirmed reduced errors, support offered credits for retries.
sam: closing play: revert quota bump after 30m, monitor for any regression, add guardrail to prevent auto-retry storms on client side.
kai: will also add a safe backoff to the runtime so long-running requests get early hint responses instead of full requeues.
jessica: thanks team — paging cleared, handoff to oncall for next 2 hours to watch for regression. :thumbsup:
summary: Short-lived us-west-2 runtime backlog caused by feature-induced token surge; disabled feature, bumped customer soft quotas, reduced max_in_flight, enacted shedding and timeout tuning; customer impact mitigated and follow-ups scheduled.
